published.citation: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 45556: effective temperature 7098 +/- 183 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043): 7098 +/- 183 K, https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 80404 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 3699 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 3699 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
